description: Melt (metal) value of any gold, silver or platinum item at live spot: weight x purity x spot. Weight in troy oz, grams, kilograms or pennyweight.

purity.description: Metal fineness as a fraction, for example 0.999, 0.9167 (22k), 0.925 (sterling), 0.90 (US 90% coins).

unit.description: ozt = troy ounce, g = gram, kg = kilogram, dwt = pennyweight.

title: Melt value calculator
